lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Then why did you just say no? Do you want Jodi to go to prison too?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Why was the wash machine running that night? What did you guys put in the wash machine?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: I didn’t know the washing machine was going.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Where was Teresa when Jodi called? Do ya know?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: How many times did Jodi call?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Can you draw me the way the bedroom looked that day. Go ahead and draw the bedroom.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Right here. (pause) And there’s like a closet right over here.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: So if you look in door you’re looking in this way?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: And this is the hallway? OK. So now the bed’s over here. He changed it after he killed her?
